        print(row)

python3 -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
sql = """
SELECT (SELECT high FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period=\"Q2FY2025\" AND measure=\"GAAP diluted EPS\") + 
       (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period=\"Q2FY2025\") AS guidance_upper
"""
print(conn.execute(sql).fetchone())
'

python3 -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
sql = """
SELECT (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end=\"2024-11-30\" AND months=3 AND measure=\"Non-GAAP diluted EPS\") -
       ((SELECT high FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period=\"Q2FY2025\" AND measure=\"GAAP diluted EPS\") + 
       (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM guidance_adjustments WHERE fiscal_period=\"Q2FY2025\"))
"""
print(conn.execute(sql).fetchone())
'

python3 -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
sql = """
SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category=\"Operating expense\" THEN amount WHEN category=\"Income tax expense\" THEN -amount ELSE 0 END)
FROM adjustments
WHERE period_end=\"2024-11-30\" AND months=3
"""
print(conn.execute(sql).fetchone())
'

python3 -c '
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect("/workspace/data.sqlite")
sql = """
SELECT ((SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end=\"2024-11-30\" AND months=3 AND measure=\"Net income\") +
       (SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN category=\"Operating expense\" THEN amount WHEN category=\"Income tax expense\" THEN -amount ELSE 0 END)
        FROM adjustments WHERE period_end=\"2024-11-30\" AND months=3)) * 100.0 / 
       (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end=\"2024-11-30\" AND months=3 AND measure=\"Total revenues\")
"""
print(conn.execute(sql).fetchone())
'
